meta.name: system-map-module-map-generator
meta.description: Generate concise module map with responsibilities, dependencies, and data flow, including a Mermaid diagram. Use for onboarding and architecture reviews.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成模块地图，理清职责、依赖与数据流
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速理解或展示系统模块结构
copy.tagline_en: Generate module maps to clarify responsibilities, dependencies, and data flow
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly understand or present system module structure

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会生成一份系统模块地图文件（SYSTEM_MAP.md），包含各模块职责、依赖关系、数据流以及 Mermaid 图表，用于快速理解项目架构。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 分析项目架构、进行新人入职引导或架构评审时触发。

say.text: 请生成当前项目的系统模块地图。
say.note: Claude 会输出 SYSTEM_MAP.md 文件。

say.text: 帮我画一个模块依赖的 Mermaid 图。
say.note: Claude 会生成包含 Mermaid 图表的模块地图。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates a system module map file (SYSTEM_MAP.md) with module responsibilities, dependencies, data flow, and a Mermaid diagram for quick project comprehension.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to analyze project architecture, conduct onboarding, or perform architecture review.

say_en.text: Generate the system module map for the current project.
Draw a Mermaid diagram of module dependencies.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a module map with a Mermaid diagram.
